entities.name: Auckland Geddes, 1st Baron Geddes
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Auckland Campbell Geddes, 1st Baron Geddes, was a British academic, soldier, politician and diplomat. He was a member of David Lloyd George's coalition government during the First World War and also served as Ambassador to the United States.
